meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容变成支持备注和跳转的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常要把资料整理成可演示的幻灯片
copy.tagline_en: Turn your content into a presentation deck with speaker notes and branching.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn rough notes into a navigable slide deck for presenting.

howto.what: 装好后，当 Claude 按此技能工作时，会产出可导航翻页的 HyperFrames 幻灯片组，而不是渲染好的视频文件；含独立幻灯片、逐条渐显、热点跳转分支、演讲备注；也可以把现有网页转成此类幻灯片组。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求做幻灯片时直接启用；若只是提到“演示文稿”“pitch deck”等相近需求，或想把网页转成幻灯片，会先询问确认；经 /hyperframes 路由则默认已确认。

say.text: 做一个标题为“产品发布”的幻灯片，共三页。
say.note: 会直接产出可翻页的幻灯片组。

say.text: 把这份文档转成幻灯片，尽量保持原有的排版。
say.note: 会先确认，再按原页面视觉转换。

say.text: 在幻灯片第二页加一个热点，跳转到附录页。
say.note: 幻灯片中会增加可点击的跳转交互。

howto.what_en: Claude authors an interactive HyperFrames slideshow (discrete slides, fragment reveals, hotspots, branching, presenter mode with notes), not a linear MP4, and can convert an existing page into that deck.
howto.when_en: Triggered on explicit slideshow requests; for similar asks like presentation, pitch deck, or page-to-deck conversion, Claude confirms first. Via /hyperframes, intent is pre-confirmed.

say_en.text: Create a slideshow titled Q3 Review with three slides.
Turn this document into a slideshow, preserving the layout.
Add a hotspot on slide two that jumps to the appendix.
say_en.note: Adds a clickable jump in the deck.
